sources.entry: Coluracetam - Markdown reader with Quick Look and thumbnail extensions, so .md files render on spacebar and in Finder.

summary.one_liner: Coluracetam is a macOS Markdown reader that previews .md files in Finder's Quick Look and includes a live split source/preview editor.
summary.what_it_does: Coluracetam renders Markdown files in Finder's Quick Look preview when you press the spacebar, and generates file thumbnails for them. It also provides a split editor with a live source pane and rendered preview. The rendered document supports document-wide text selection and search. The app can export documents to PDF and HTML. It reads ordinary UTF-8 .md and .markdown files and offers light and dark preview themes. Zoom is controlled with ⌘+, ⌘−, and ⌘0, and external edits to a file are reloaded without discarding unsaved changes.
use_cases: read .md files without opening an editor
export markdown to PDF or HTML
search and select text in rendered markdown
see markdown file thumbnails in Finder
notable: Same Markdown rendering in Finder Quick Look and the app's split editor
Generated file thumbnails for Markdown files
External file reloads preserve unsaved edits
caveats: Only UTF-8 .md and .markdown files are described as supported
